idiomatic: Upholding the testamentary charge, the ancestral offering has its date.

idiomatic: We shall personally attend the dragon carriage and take leave at the tomb passage.

idiomatic: Military guard officials are to guard and attend according to regulation.

idiomatic: " On the guiyou day Empress Dowager Wenming was buried at Yonggu Tomb.

literal: On the jimao day the imperial carriage visited Yonggu Tomb.
idiomatic: On the jimao day the court visited Yonggu Tomb.

idiomatic: On the gengchen day the emperor dwelt in the mourning hut and received the assembled officials at Taihe Hall; Pi, grand commandant and Prince of Dongyang, and others relied on statutory authority and firmly requested; the emperor cited ancient rites back and forth, and the assembled ministers then stopped.

literal: The account is in the Treatise on Rites.
idiomatic: The account is in the Treatise on Rites.

literal: Prince of Jingzhao Taixing had committed a crime; he was removed from office and his noble rank was reduced.
idiomatic: Taixing, Prince of Jingzhao, had committed a crime; he was removed from office and his noble rank was reduced.

literal: An edict said: "The dukes and ministers repeatedly relied on the testamentary charge of the golden booklet and the expedient forms of middle antiquity, requesting that after the burial we return to the auspicious day.
idiomatic: An edict said, "The dukes and ministers repeatedly relied on the testamentary charge of the golden booklet and the expedient forms of middle antiquity, requesting that after the burial we return to the auspicious day.

literal: We think to follow remote antiquity and complete the three-year observance.
idiomatic: We think to follow remote antiquity and complete the three-year observance.

literal: According to the rites, after the yu offering comes the end of wailing.
idiomatic: According to the rites, after the yu offering comes the end of wailing.

literal: On the twenty-first day of this month we take off mourning, replacing hemp with kudzu.
idiomatic: On the twenty-first day of this month we take off mourning, replacing hemp with kudzu.

literal: Since the mourning garment is still worn above, the dukes and ministers cannot alone release mourning below; therefore at our taking off mourning the change follows the practice rite; from then on it is again reduced by degrees, weighing present and past to fix our inner intent, and also taking one strand of the testamentary charge's swift removal, roughly expressing the ministers' and sons' measureless great grief.
idiomatic: Since the mourning garment is still worn above, the dukes and ministers cannot alone release mourning below; therefore at our taking off mourning the change follows the practice rite; from then on it is again reduced by degrees, weighing present and past to fix our inner intent, and also taking one strand of the testamentary charge's swift removal, roughly expressing the ministers' and sons' measureless great grief.

literal: " On the guiwei day an edict said: "We follow remote antiquity in form and wish to complete the three-year rite.
idiomatic: " On the guiwei day an edict said, "We follow remote antiquity in form and wish to complete the three-year rite.

literal: The hundred ranks and assembled officials, relying on the golden booklet testamentary charge, would wrest our heart and follow the former court's system.
idiomatic: The hundred ranks and assembled officials, relying on the golden booklet testamentary charge, would wrest our heart and follow the former court's system.

literal: We look up at the golden booklet and bow our head in self-examination, taking from both inner intents and not permitting the multitude's debate; because the mourning garment passes its term, we complete the four seasons' yearning.
idiomatic: We look up at the golden booklet and bow our head in self-examination, taking from both inner intents and not permitting the multitude's debate; because the mourning garment passes its term, we complete the four seasons' yearning.

literal: Also upholding the sage's instruction, we respectfully carry out the proclaimed charge and dare not dwell in hidden silence alone, thereby neglecting urgent government.
idiomatic: Also upholding the sage's instruction, we respectfully carry out the proclaimed charge and dare not dwell in hidden silence alone, thereby neglecting urgent government.

literal: We hope not to fail the testament's intent and somewhat unfold the feeling of yearning in mourning.
idiomatic: We hope not to fail the testament's intent and somewhat unfold the feeling of yearning in mourning.

literal: Let it be sent down to all provinces and garrisons: at the three origins of the winter solstice, congratulatory announcements are entirely stopped.
idiomatic: Let it be sent down to all provinces and garrisons: at the three origins of the winter solstice, congratulatory announcements are entirely stopped.

literal: " On the jiashen day the imperial carriage visited Yonggu Tomb.
idiomatic: " On the jiashen day the court visited Yonggu Tomb.

literal: On the xinmao day an edict said: "The assembled officials, because the myriad affairs of state are weighty, request permission to hear government.
idiomatic: On the xinmao day an edict said, "The assembled officials, because the myriad affairs of state are weighty, request permission to hear government.

literal: We, upholding the testamentary charge, also think not to be remiss.
idiomatic: We, upholding the testamentary charge, also think not to be remiss.

literal: Yet yearning in mourning is tangled and binding; mind and spirit are confused and obstructed—we are not yet able by our own strength to attend to government in person.
idiomatic: Yet yearning in mourning is tangled and binding; mind and spirit are confused and obstructed—we are not yet able by our own strength to attend to government in person.

literal: Those close attendants who formerly held the pivots of power are all entrusted with counsel; for the time being they may be entrusted with duty; if there are doubtful matters, discuss and decide them at the time.
idiomatic: Those close attendants who formerly held the pivots of power are all entrusted with counsel; for the time being they may be entrusted with duty; if there are doubtful matters, discuss and decide them at the time.

literal: " Eleventh month, day jiayin, an edict said: "As the season approaches the solstice, yearning in mourning collapses us; among all in the ministerial ranks, who is not choked with grief?
idiomatic: " In the eleventh month, on the jiayin day, an edict said, "As the season approaches the solstice, yearning in mourning collapses us; among all in the ministerial ranks, who is not choked with grief?

literal: Inner and outer officeholders of former court rank and all miscellaneous guests from the regions—on the day of the winter solstice, all are permitted to enter mourning attendance.
idiomatic: Inner and outer officeholders of former court rank and all miscellaneous guests from the regions—on the day of the winter solstice, all are permitted to enter mourning attendance.

literal: Those of third rank and above in mourning garments attend again in the evening; the rest attend only at dawn.
idiomatic: Those of third rank and above in mourning garments attend again in the evening; the rest attend only at dawn.

literal: The nodes of bowing and wailing follow the separate protocol entirely.
idiomatic: The nodes of bowing and wailing follow the separate protocol entirely.

idiomatic: " On the dingsi day Xiao Ze sent envoys with tribute.

idiomatic: If they band together with powerful magnates and bully the solitary and weak, there is a fixed punishment by statute.

idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the fifteenth year, on the dingmao day, the emperor first heard government in the eastern chamber of Imperial Trust.

literal: The left and right historiography offices were first separately established.
idiomatic: The left and right historiography offices were first separately established.

idiomatic: The state of Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

idiomatic: On the jichou day Xiao Ze sent envoys with tribute.

idiomatic: From the first month there was no rain until the guiyou day.

literal: The myriad realms have guilt; it lies in us alone.
idiomatic: The myriad realms have guilt; it lies in us alone.

literal: Now all under Heaven has lost its support; hidden and manifest share grief; if the spirits have soul, they surely cannot yet bear to rest in peace at the offering—how can we, when the four seasons are not yet complete, then wish to perform sacrifices?
idiomatic: Now all under Heaven has lost its support; hidden and manifest share grief; if the spirits have soul, they surely cannot yet bear to rest in peace at the offering—how can we, when the four seasons are not yet complete, then wish to perform sacrifices?

idiomatic: We should only examine ourselves and blame ourselves, awaiting Heaven's punishment.
